claim.scope: The retrospective limit of the prospective responsibility intervention; later retrieval can separately repair historical records.

signal_basis.value: Responsibility for attaching approval evidence becomes explicit prospectively, and missing attachments decrease across comparable observation periods if volume permits. Historical record repair through later retrieval remains a separate activity.
signal_basis.scope: Future covered orders, with new-order outcomes distinguished from historical backlog repairs.

rationale: Improved attachment practices for future orders do not themselves supply missing documentation for past orders. Historical gaps require separate record repair, so the observed prospective improvement licenses this explicitly bounded retrospective limit.
